title: Exploring Cross-lingual Latent Transplantation: Mutual Opportunities and Open Challenges

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model performance disparities across high-, medium-, and low-resource languages using multilingual understanding and generation benchmarks (XNLI, XQuAD, XCOPA, MKQA).

Measuring the model's cultural adaptability and ability to accurately reflect diverse country-specific opinions using cross-national survey datasets (GlobalOpinionQA, CulturalBench) by prompting the model with country-specific personas.
